rules.title: Centralized error handler
rules.text: Route all errors through one error-handling middleware; Express 5 forwards rejected async handlers to it, while Express 4 needs a wrapper.

rules.title: Validate requests
rules.text: Validate params, query and body with a schema (zod, joi, typebox) before the handler runs.

rules.title: Security middleware
rules.text: Apply helmet or equivalent security headers and disable the x-powered-by header.

rules.title: Thin route handlers
rules.text: Keep route handlers thin; put logic in services that do not import req or res.

rules.title: Body size limits
rules.text: Set body size limits and request timeouts.
